description: Create, edit, render, verify, and export presentation slide decks (.pptx) with duya's pptx office skill.

interface.longDescription: Create, edit, inspect, render, verify, and export presentation slide decks locally, including PPTX authoring. Adds an anti-slop writing-quality playbook (wording taxonomy and title rules), template-following and cover-design guidance, and finance-deck conventions on top of the OOXML editing pipeline. Use Presentations when the durable output or target is a deck, slidedeck, presentation deck, slide deck, slides, PowerPoint, presentation, or speaker notes.
